use-case-cnv-detection-characterisation.text: On HG002 deletions, DRAGEN 4.2 with SV-informed CNV calling found 87 to 100% of deletions in every size bin, with precision 0.99 to 1.00; this is the developers' own benchmark. CNVnator matched it above 10 kb but found only 26% of deletions of 1 to 5 kb and 51% of 5 to 10 kb. On NA12878, LUMPY, DELLY and Manta recovered 88 to 94% of known CNVs, but only 20 to 33% of their calls matched; Manta and CNVnator were used to build this truth set, which can favour them. The other callers recovered 1 to 43%. None of the comparisons shown reports duplications separately, and none covers tumour samples or long reads.
